newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yip's Hang Cheung to issue staff shares.
newsitem.headline: Yip's Hang Cheung to issue staff shares.

text.p: Paint manufacturer Yip's Hang Cheung (Holdings) Ltd said it would place 11.74 million new shares, or 2.4 percent of the enlarged share capital, at HK$0.83 per share with its 198 employees in Hong Kong.
"The placing will widen employee participation in the future of the company," chairman Ip Chi Shing said in a statement.
The company's directors, who are excluded from the offer, will hold 64.5 percent of the company after the deal, it said.

Out of the gross proceeds of HK$9.74 million, the company would provide employees with a total of HK$7.98 million in interest-free loans to allow them to subscribe, repayable in 36 monthly payroll deductions, it said.
Net proceeds would be used as working capital, the company said. Shares in Yip's Hang Cheung (Holdings) Ltd rose HK$0.06 to HK$0.93 in late Wednesday morning trade.
